subject: Atlas Retail — buying path, pilot milestones & owner commitments
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas Retail discovery — summary, proposed milestones & asks

Ellen / team — thanks again for the 45-minute call earlier. Quick written recap so we have an agreed starting place and owners for the next 6–8 weeks. I’ve attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (RWI-MAP-draft-v2.pdf) and a rough sizing estimate.

Key pain + goals we heard
- High volume of customer chat and returns-related triage taking agent time — estimated 30% of support load.
- Inconsistent answer quality from existing rule-based automations; goal is to raise first-contact resolution and reduce avg handle time.
- Compliance: logs retention and auditability for customer PII redaction.

Success metrics you called out
- Pilot: 10% reduction in agent handle time; maintain accuracy >= 92% on a sampled set.
- Post-pilot decision: Exec procurement approval by end of May (procurement timeline you mentioned).

Proposed mutual action plan (high level) — owners / dates
1) Contract + Procurement intake — Atlas Procurement (Tom/Procurement) — target: 2027-05-28 (owner: Tom Rivera)
2) Security + legal exchanges — Atlas security + Redwood Security (deliverable: security brief + questionnaire) — target: 2027-05-21 (owner: Ellen / Ben)
3) Pilot scoping & data prep — Atlas Product + Redwood Solutions (deliverable: data extract + evaluation prompts) — target: 2027-06-11 (owner: Karthik / Atlas PM)
4) Pilot run (4 weeks) — infrastructure + monitoring in Redwood Dedicated — 2027-06-21 to 2027-07-18 (owner: Redwood infra & Atlas Ops)
5) Pilot demo & results review — execs + CS — 2027-07-22 (owner: Ben / Monica)

Immediate asks from our side
- Please confirm procurement approver and timeline (Tom?) and copy to procurement@atlasretail.com.
- Share the security questionnaire items you need; we’ve attached 'redwood-security-brief.pdf' as a starter.
- Confirm Atlas PM for data prep so Karthik can schedule the scoping workshop.

Attachments: RWI-MAP-draft-v2.pdf (mutual action plan), sizing-estimate.xlsx

Next step: If this looks right, can you confirm owners for line items 1–3 by end of day Friday? We’ll lock dates and circulate a final MAP.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0119

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail discovery — summary, proposed milestones & asks

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and matches our notes. Quick replies / clarifications:

- Confirming Tom Rivera (copied) is the procurement lead and procurement@atlasretail.com should be on any legal/contract threads. Target procurement approval date: 2027-05-28.
- Security: we will need a completed questionnaire and evidence on data handling (esp. how PII is redacted in logs). Please route security docs to me and Tom.
- Pilot target: still aiming for a July pilot start; we’ll need final scope and an estimate of how much data engineering support is required.

I’ve added Tom here. Tom — can you confirm whether Atlas requires a PO or contract signature before pilot infra work begins?

Ellen Park
Director, Customer Experience | Atlas Retail
ellen.park@atlasretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0148

Ellen / Tom — thanks for the quick confirmation. A few updates based on your notes:

- I’ve pushed a short security supplement (redwood-security-brief.pdf) into the MAP and highlighted where we can provide logs with redaction. We’ll also fill your questionnaire — can you share the doc or portal link?
- Procurement: understood on the 05/28 target. If Atlas needs a PO before infra work, we can scope an ‘onboarding hold’ period where we do architecture prep without provisioning customer data.
- Data engineering: Karthik will run a 60-minute scoping workshop the week of 5/24 to size the work. Please nominate the Atlas PM/product engineer who will join.

Updated milestone dates (draft, based on procurement target):
- Security evidence delivered: 2027-05-18 (owner: Ben / Redwood Security)
- Scoping workshop: week of 2027-05-24 (owner: Karthik / Atlas PM)
- Data deliverable due: 2027-06-07 (owner: Atlas data team)
- Infra ready + pilot dry run: 2027-06-18 (owner: Redwood infra)
- Pilot window: 2027-06-21 to 2027-07-18

I’ve uploaded a revised MAP: RWI-MAP-draft-v2.pdf (attached). If Tom confirms procurement steps, I’ll escalate legal to prepare an SOW/PO option for the pilot.

Ben Carter
